Instagram Video Editor for PC — Initial Release

- Launches cloud-based Instagram video editing for PC: upload, describe edits, and export in under a minute.
- 100 free credits for new users (7-day expiry), with easy anonymous token setup.
- Automatic video resizing, trimming, audio track, and text overlay support for Instagram posts, Reels, and Stories.
- No timeline UI or export settings; just upload clips and type out instructions.
- Handles file uploads up to 500MB, multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.), and exports to 1080p by default.
- Real-time job progress, detailed error messages, and seamless iterative editing in one session.
